candidate_summary: Senior B2B marketing operations leader; Adobe AEP/AJO, Marketo, Salesforce, ABM. Based in the NYC metro.
geography: Remote (US), NYC metro / CT / NJ / Westchester hybrid, or major US metros (MA, DC, VA, MD, FL, TX, CA). No international roles.
comp_floor: Base salary at least $200K for NYC-metro or NYC+remote roles; at least $250K base for all other markets. Undisclosed comp is allowed but must be flagged.
exclusions: Sales enablement / GTM enablement / sales readiness / LMS / SKO roles
AI solutions engineering, applied AI architect, solutions consulting (hands-on model/RAG/agent building)
Corporate IT strategy, technology investment or infrastructure architecture roles
Quota-carrying sales (AE/BDR/SDR/account manager), pre-sales, customer success, primary product management
Consumer CPG/FMCG, retail, clinical healthcare, traditional (non-FinTech) financial services, government, non-profit, education, real estate, insurance
Any role whose disclosed base ceiling is below the applicable floor
